playerPlayPause.label: Play/pause
playerPlayPause.description: Load a song from the library first.

playerPrevious.label: Previous song
playerPrevious.description: With no previous song, returns to the start of this one.

playerNext.label: Next song
playerNext.description: Follows the current playlist or performance plan.

audio.label: Audio
audio.guidance: Volume and mute don't affect background music; save after transposing.

lyrics.label: Lyrics timing
lyrics.guidance: Adjusts the lyrics chosen for the current song and saves automatically.

usage.configure: Select Set next to a feature, press the keys you want, then select Apply. Use ⋯ to disable a feature or restore its default keys.
usage.typing: Shortcuts don't work while you type.
usage.controls: Custom shortcuts pause while you use buttons, menus or sliders; each press runs once.
usage.arrows: Arrow keys in lists, panels or lyrics don't change the volume at the same time.
usage.hold: Hold a default shortcut to repeat it.

scope.global: Works while other apps are in front; each press runs once.
scope.custom: Doesn't work while you type or use buttons, menus or sliders; each press runs once.
scope.defaultVolume: Doesn't fire while you type or use buttons, menus or panels; hold to repeat.
scope.defaultVolumeShift: Doesn't fire while you type or use buttons, menus or panels; hold to repeat; Shift also works.
scope.default: Doesn't fire in text fields; hold to repeat.
scope.defaultShift: Doesn't fire in text fields; hold to repeat; Shift also works.
scope.unset: Works in the main window only; set the keys first.

sections.practiceGuidance: Waveform: Lyrics editor → Edit → Adjust timing → clock beside a line → source waveform.

contexts.cueHandles: Line start, end and whole-line handles
contexts.readingEdit: Editing a reading or lyrics source name

actions.tempo: Speed up or slow down by 0.05×
actions.guideVocal: Turn the guide vocal on or off
actions.pageToStart: Move one page toward the start
actions.pageToEnd: Move one page toward the end
actions.fivePages: Move five pages toward the start or end
actions.showEdges: Show the start or end of the song
actions.zoom: Zoom the waveform in or out
actions.selectTrack: Select the song, open or play it
actions.moveColumn: Move the column left or right
actions.finishNote: Finish editing and keep the text

notes.guideVocal: Doesn't change the guide vocal you hear yourself.
notes.viewOnly: Moves the view only, not the playback position.
notes.panelView: Shared by the main workspace, side panel and waveform panel; select a panel first.
notes.restorePanel: Only while a panel is maximized; text fields and menus come first.
notes.trackRow: Follows the action of the list it is in.
notes.sliderReset: Some keyboards or systems may not support this.
notes.photoStack: The back photo flips backward; the front and middle photos flip forward.
notes.mediaKeys: Handled by Windows; can't be changed here.

conflict.named: These keys are already used for “{command}”. Choose another combination.
conflict.generic: This shortcut is already in use. Choose another combination.
conflict.invalid: These keys can't be used. Choose another combination.

block.title: Keyboard shortcuts
block.guidance: Select Set to change keys; see How to use for other controls.
block.globalHint: Background keys need Ctrl or Alt. Test them, then apply; testing doesn't run the feature.
block.recordingPrompt: Press the keys you want; the feature won't run now.
block.testFirst: Test the keys, then select Apply to save.
block.applyToSave: Select Apply to save and use it.
block.globalNeedsKeys: Set keys under Background first, then turn them on.
block.globalGuidance: Shortcuts that work while other apps are in front.
block.sessionOnly: Off for this session; the setting for next launch isn't saved yet. Retry or reload.
block.holdModifier: With default keys you can also hold
block.fixedHint: These controls are fixed; select the matching panel or area first.

errors.invalid: The shortcut settings are damaged; the original file was kept.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This shortcut settings format isn't supported yet; the original file was kept.
errors.conflict: Shortcuts were changed elsewhere. Reload them.
errors.occupied: Another app is using these keys. Choose another combination or retry.
errors.keysHeld: Release all keys and try again.
errors.busy: Shortcuts are busy. Try again shortly.
errors.degraded: Background shortcuts are paused. Reload shortcuts and try again.
errors.unsupportedGlobal: This background shortcut isn't available yet.
errors.readFailed: Shortcuts could not be read. Reload them.
errors.runtimeReadFailed: Background shortcut status could not be read. Reload it.
errors.unusable: This shortcut can't be used. Set it again.
errors.saveUnconfirmed: The shortcut save isn't confirmed. Reload and try again.
errors.testFailed: Couldn't check whether the keys are available. Retry.
errors.testFailedReload: Couldn't check whether the keys are available. Reload and try again.
